import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = data.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_sales))
ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Payment Method Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
payment_counts = data['payment_method'].value_counts()
ax2.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=sns.color_palette("pastel"))
ax2.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Sales by Customer Age Group
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_sales = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax3.barh(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(age_sales)))
ax3.set_title('Sales by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
takeaway_sales = data.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
ax4.bar(labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 5. Sales by Size
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
size_sales = data.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = size_sales.reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)
ax5.bar(size_sales.index, size_sales.values, color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#AA96DA'])
ax5.set_title('Sales by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 6. Sales over Time
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
hourly_sales = data.groupby('time')['total'].sum()
ax6.plot(range(len(hourly_sales)), hourly_sales.values, marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#FF6B6B')
ax6.set_title('Sales by Time of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Time')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(hourly_sales)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(hourly_sales.index, rotation=45)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 7. Quantity Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
quantity_counts = data['quantity'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.bar(quantity_counts.index, quantity_counts.values, color='#6C5CE7')
ax7.set_title('Quantity Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Quantity')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 8. Average Price by Product
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
avg_price = data.groupby('product')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax8.barh(avg_price.index, avg_price.values, color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(avg_price)))
ax8.set_title('Average Price by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Average Price ($)')
ax8.set_ylabel('Product')

# 9. Summary Statistics
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_text = f"""
Summary Statistics:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Total Revenue: ${data['total'].sum():.2f}
Total Orders: {len(data)}
Avg Order Value: ${data['total'].mean():.2f}
Avg Quantity: {data['quantity'].mean():.2f}

Most Popular Product:
{data['product'].value_counts().index[0]}

Top Age Group:
{data['customer_age_group'].value_counts().index[0]}
"""
ax9.text(0.1, 0.5, summary_text, fontsize=11, family='monospace',
         verticalalignment='center', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', 
         facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.3))

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
